sentences.text: 2. State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp  ----Respondents For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Arpit Surana For Respondent(s) : Mr. Tushar Moad  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE MANOJ KUMAR GARG Order 05/11/2024

The present transfer petition has been filed by the petitioner with the prayer that the Misc. Case No. 746/2019 pending before the Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Beawar be transferred to the court of Judicial Magistrate, Abu Road.

Counsel for the petitioner argued that the petitioner had filed criminal case under Section 498A,
406, 323, 354 IPC which is pending before the court of Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate,
Beawar, however, now she is residing at Abu Road.

The petitioner has also filed a case under Section 12 of Domestic Violence Act and application under Section 125 Cr.P.C. before the court of Judicial Magistrate, Abu Road and the divorce petition filed by the respondent husband at Beawar has already been transferred to the court at Abu Road.

It is submitted that being a lady living with old aged parents, it is very difficult for her to travel to Beawar [2024:RJ-JD:44451] (2 of 3)
[CRLTP-8/2024] from her residential place at Abu Road, therefore, the Case No. 746/2019 may be transferred to court of Judicial Magistrate, Abu Road.
Per contra, counsel for the respondent opposed the prayer made by the petitioner and submits that the petitioner has left the matrimonial home without any reason on her own.

It is argued that no case is made out for transfer of the case from Beawar to Abu road and the petition is liable to be Priyanka vs Chandraprakash (2024:Rj-Jd:44451) on 5 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/54047751/
1 rejected.
I have heard counsel for the parties and perused the documents on record.

The petitioner has filed criminal case under Section 498A, 406, 323, 354 IPC which is pending before the court of Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Beawar but the petitioner is residing at Abu Road.
She has also resorted to legal proceedings against the respondent at Abu Road.

Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Vaishali Shridhar Jagtap Vs. Shridhar Vishwanath Jagtap reported in AIR 2016 SC 3584 while allowing the appeal filed by wife, directed the case to be transferred from Mumbai to Barshi which is 400 km away from Mumbai.

opennyai_summary.decision:
Recently, the co-ordinate Bench of this Court in the case of Ekta Dhadhich vs. Rajendra Prasad Sharma (S.B. Civil Transfer application NO. 72/2021) decided on 30.09.2021 directed the case to be transferred from Ajmer to Family Court at Kota.

Stay application also stands disposed of.
